steps.observation: Work on this for 10 seconds; do not stop early. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
1. Expand and improve public transit  
   • Invest in frequent, reliable buses, light rail, and subways  
   • Integrate bike-share systems and safe bike lanes  
   • Offer discounted fares or subsidies to encourage ridership  

2. Retrofit buildings for energy efficiency  
   • Upgrade insulation, windows, and HVAC systems  
   • Install smart thermostats and LED lighting  
   • Provide incentives or low-interest loans for green retrofits  

3. Promote low-emission transportation  
   • Install widespread electric-vehicle charging infrastructure  
   • Introduce congestion pricing or low-emission zones  
   • Support car-sharing programs and offer rebates for EV purchases
